concerns.text: Task T006 assumes the presence of `data/raw/synthetic_ukb.parquet` (a synthetic dataset generated with seed 42 in T004). However, T004 only creates this file when the real UK Biobank download fails; if the real download succeeds, the synthetic file will not exist, causing T006 to lack its required input. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer risk and violates the foundational‑task ordering principle.
